summary: whalibmob@5.33.23: static patterns matched without traced corroboration
details: Static keyword co-occurrence rules matched inside lib/MediaService.js (fs + http/https + readFileSync + https.request), lib/Registration.js (repeated 'ping' tokens), lib/WebVersion.js (curl / https.get / ps tokens), and lib/socks.js (curl, POST, hostname tokens). These patterns describe filesystem, process, and network primitives co-occurring in the shipped sources, but no traced code path demonstrates a concrete installer-side harm: no specific installer secret (env dump, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser store, wallet) is shown being read, no attacker-controlled destination is named, and the package.json lifecycle behavior and reachability of these primitives at install/import time are not established from the available evidence. The matched tokens are consistent with legitimate uses (HTTP client code, SOCKS/proxy helpers, media handling, diagnostic ping) as well as with exfiltration shapes; the current evidence does not distinguish between them.
